subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should OpenClaw extend the Feishu plugin from sender/topic session isolation and DM dynamic agents into automatic group per-sender subagent lifecycle management?
rationale: The request crosses product behavior, security boundaries, memory isolation, skills/config ownership, quotas, cleanup, and channel delivery semantics; current main has adjacent primitives but no approved default for group auto-spawning.

options.title: Design Default-Off Feishu Group Subagents
options.body: Approve a bounded Feishu-plugin design that is explicit, configurable, and validated for memory/security isolation before implementation.

options.title: Keep Existing Session Scoping
options.body: Treat `groupSessionScope` plus manual/thread-bound subagent flows as the supported path and document that automatic group subagents are out of scope for now.

options.title: Prototype Externally First
options.body: Ask interested teams to prototype this as a separate Feishu/ClawHub integration until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Design Default-Off Feishu Group Subagents
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded Feishu-plugin design that is explicit, configurable, and validated for memory/security isolation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The request is primarily Feishu plugin product/security behavior, and package metadata names this handle as the Feishu community-maintained owner signal.
